title: Streaming Pipeline Regression in Transformers v5
author: davidmezzetti

comments.author: Sammy-Dabbas
comments.body:
I looked into this and I think I have a fix ready, pending your go-ahead to open a PR.

Root cause: the `inputs = list(inputs)` in `Pipeline.__call__` was added in the v5 chat template change (#42326) so it could read `inputs[0]` to detect chat-style inputs. Generators are not subscriptable, so it materializes the whole thing just to peek at the first element, and on a large or streaming generator that forces the entire stream into memory and OOMs. In v4 there was no such conversion; generators would fall through to the existing lazy `get_iterator` / `PipelineIterator` path.

The fix i have peeks only the first item with `next()`. If it is a chat message, materialize just that single bounded conversation as a `Chat`. Otherwise it  reattach the peeked item to the generator and let it stream through the existing lazy iterator path, so a large generator is never fully materialized. Im avoiding just dropping `GeneratorType` from the container types which is the workaround in the issue, since that silently breaks single-chat-as-generator detection. I have a regression test asserting the generator input is not materialized, and it passes locally.


I also see @ojasvi24-coder offered to take this. Either way, I'm glad to help get this fixed. If you'd like me to open the PR I can do that right away,
